name: IRIS / 09

source.preservation: Exact immutable copy of the downloaded Revision III GLSL; integration camera overrides live in iris09-stage.mjs, not this source file.

implementation.hostContract: FragCoord uniforms and fragment output supplied by the host

geometry.bladeIntersection: Analytic intersections of two circular prisms, an outer cylinder and a finite-thickness canted slab; leaves rotate about individually placed hinges.
geometry.housing: Signed-distance-field raymarching of annular machined forms, modeled grip flutes, mounting ears, through-bores, recessed screws and actuator lever.
geometry.opticalVolumes: Two closed, recessed plano-convex elements separated by air.
geometry.units: Authored scene units; no calibrated manufacturing scale.

appearance: Anisotropic GGX with height-correlated Smith masking and Fresnel response
Three finite rectangular studio emitters with shared illumination and reflection profiles
Filtered machining detail, vector engraving and sparse handling marks
Three-channel geometric dispersion, coated Fresnel interfaces and Beer-Lambert absorption
Source ACES-style display curve and gamma 1/2.2

limitations: A complete authored shader scene, not an exported CAD mesh or a full path tracer.
Actuator and leaf motion share an authored parameter; this is not a force simulation or a manufacturing, strength or fatigue certification.
Indirect illumination and ambient occlusion are approximations, not solved global illumination.
Secondary optical reflections evaluate opaque geometry or the analytic environment; they do not recursively traverse all glass branches.
Shadow visibility is approximated separately from area-light quadrature; three-point iris occlusion is applied to leaf shading, not universally to every receiver.
Three RGB wavelengths and reconstructed material values are not measured full-spectrum transport.
This provenance record establishes source identity and code features, not browser frame rate or visual equivalence to an offline reference.

excludedArchive.reason: The later cleanup ZIP contained Revision 2. Its shader, captures, README and validation results are archival and must not substitute for or certify this production Revision III source.
